title: RealisticChicken
description: RealisticChicken makes chicken breeding more realistic by replacing instant baby spawning with egg laying.
body:
# RealisticChicken

**RealisticChicken** makes chicken breeding more realistic by replacing instant baby spawning with egg laying.

In vanilla Minecraft, chickens automatically lay eggs and breeding immediately creates chicks. This plugin changes that behavior to simulate a more natural and realistic reproduction system.

## Features

* ~~Chickens no longer lay eggs automatically over time~~ — Automatic eggs are converted to infertile eggs
* Breeding chickens will lay eggs instead of instantly spawning chicks
* Each breeding produces **1–3 eggs randomly**
* Breeding still gives **vanilla-equivalent experience (1–7 XP)**
* Chickens enter the same **5-minute cooldown** as vanilla breeding
* Supports multiple languages — English and Japanese supported for egg descriptions
* The language can be set in the plugin config
  
## Egg Types

* **Fertilized Egg (有精卵)** — Can hatch into a chick when thrown
* **Infertile Egg (無精卵)** — Will not hatch, produced automatically by chickens over time

## How it works

Vanilla:

* Feed seeds → Chick appears instantly
* Eggs are laid automatically over time.

RealisticChicken:

* Feed seeds → Eggs are laid
* Throw the eggs to hatch chicks (fertilized eggs only)

This creates a more immersive and realistic farming experience.

## Compatibility

* Supports **Paper, Purpur, Spigot, and Bukkit**
* Supports **Minecraft 1.21.x**
* Requires **Java 21 or newer**
* No dependencies required

## Performance

RealisticChicken uses only two lightweight event listeners and does not run any repeating tasks.
It is safe for servers of any size and has negligible performance impact.

## Installation

1. Download the plugin JAR
2. Place it in your server's `/plugins/` folder
3. Restart the server
4. Done

## Perfect for

* Survival servers
* Realism-focused servers
* Farming and economy servers
* Vanilla+ gameplay enhancement

---

Make chicken breeding more realistic and immersive.
